comparison.objective: Insert a carton divider into mounting slots while stabilizing the carton; candidate adjusts a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable-part alignment and depth insertion versus rigid small-tool engagement, rotary adjustment and setscrew locking.
comparison.success_condition: Divider seated within 2 mm versus two non-bottoming carriage stops without rebound, overload or drift.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual stabilization is generic; slot insertion and dynamic damping calibration test different abilities. Setup and scoring fields are missing.
